user_saw: Some ClawRouter vision models appeared text-only in chat, and chat ignored the selected endpoint’s token limits.
summary: ClawRouter discovery now uses the selected endpoint’s declared image support and token limits while keeping the router’s pricing cap on output.
reasoning: The original ClawRouter integration inferred image support from model names and read token limits from pricing fields. The newer router catalog supplied endpoint-specific modalities and limits that the existing projection ignored. The first local use of the versioned contract was for hosted web search, and the local history does not identify when the router began supplying the affected fields.
